title_en: The Second Pair of Shoes Under the Umbrella
story_zh: 外頭根本沒下雨。我把黑傘靠在玄關，它卻不停滴水。更怪的是，水滴竟往天花板飄。天花板浮出一圈圈水痕，像一座倒掛的池塘。我打開走廊監視器，畫面裡空無一人。只有傘的影子不對。監視器裡，那道影子像兩個人並肩站著。可是家裡明明只有我。我伸手撐開傘。傘面內側黏著一張濕透的收據：「乘客兩位，單程。」日期竟是明天。地板忽然冒出一串濕腳印，從玄關一步步走向我。每多一枚腳印，傘骨就輕輕響一下。我衝向大門。門外卻下著暴雨，有人撐著一模一樣的黑傘，穿著我的外套，安靜地等著。那人慢慢抬起頭，是我的臉。嘴巴沒動，我的聲音卻從傘裡傳來：「你那一程，已經到了。」我把傘丟出去，雨瞬間停了。手機亮起：「乘客一位已下車。」我低頭看門邊，竟有兩雙鞋。第二雙正穿在我的腳上，而我已經感覺不到自己的腳。
story_en: It wasn't raining when I got home. But the black umbrella by my door began to drip. The drops floated upward, toward the ceiling. Water spread across the plaster, like a pond hanging upside down. I checked the hallway camera. It showed an empty corridor. Then the umbrella's shadow moved. On the camera, it looked like two people standing together. But I lived alone. I opened the umbrella. A damp receipt was pinned inside. It read: TWO PASSENGERS. ONE WAY. The date printed underneath was tomorrow. Wet footprints appeared on the floor, coming straight toward me. Each new print made a tiny clicking sound inside the umbrella. I ran to the front door. Beyond it, rain crashed through the hallway. A figure stood under an identical black umbrella, wearing my coat. The figure looked up. It had my face. Its mouth didn't move, but my voice came from the umbrella: YOUR RIDE HAS ARRIVED. I threw the umbrella outside. The rain stopped. My phone lit up: ONE PASSENGER HAS EXITED. I looked down. Two pairs of shoes stood by the door. One pair was on my feet. But I couldn't feel my feet anymore.
